newsitem.title: PERU: Peru fish sector May yr-on-yr GDP growth 16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru fish sector May yr-on-yr GDP growth 16 pct.

text.p: Peru's Fisheries Ministry said Thursday the sector's year-on-year May gross domestic product (GDP) growth was 16 percent.
A ministry statement said this was largely due to a 241,200-tonne rise in May's catch of fish and sea species, compared with the same month last year, to a total 1.499 million tonnes.
The statement added that Peru's fishmeal exports rose 31.8 percent in the first five months, compared with the same period last year, to $567.33 million.
Exports of Peru's second most important fish product, raw fish oil, were up 92.6 percent to $35.4 million.
The total catch in the first five months was up 7.9 percent to 4.854 million tonnes.
